summary.text: Sam Jenkins is a Democratic member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 39 (Bossier and Caddo parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official Senate member page. Sam Jenkins is vice chair of the Revenue and Fiscal Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as Southern University, B.A., Political Science; Southern University Law Center, J.D.

The page lists committee assignments including Revenue and Fiscal Affairs (vice chair), Judiciary A, Natural Resources, Senate and Governmental Affairs, and the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
